content:
GrowableOres Extension 需要 GrowableOres;

A simple mod subsidiary of GrowableOres add a machine to help you process your ore cane.

GrowableOres 連結

Fabric(CurseForge 連結)

Neoforge(CurseForge 連結)

Forge(CurseForge 連結)

功能與特性

This mod add a machine to help you process your ore cane to ore.

 

配方

1.16 使用黃金取代銅。

本模組支援：(與 GrowableOres 相同)
